---
title: "1 · Introduction"
subtitle: "Course organisation, ceteris paribus and selection bias"
---

The opening topic sets up the software you will use all semester and introduces
the two ideas the whole course rests on: comparing like with like *(ceteris
paribus)*, and what goes wrong when the groups you compare differ for reasons
you have not measured *(selection bias)*.

## Slides

| Deck | Covers |
|:--|:--|
| 🖥 [Introduction. Organisation. Setup.](/slides/00-introduction/00-introduction.html) | Course organisation and software setup; **Ceteris Paribus**; **Selection Bias**. All three lectures are sections of this one deck. |

## Setting up R

Before the next topic, work through the ten-part video series:

→ **[📺 Getting started with R](00-getting-started-with-R.qmd)** — install R and
RStudio, set up your folders, create a project, and write your first script and
R Markdown document.

## Practising what the lecture showed

Rebuild the "Ceteris Paribus" example from the slides as an R script of your
own. This is step `hw00-08` of the
[getting started series](00-getting-started-with-R.qmd#hw00-08).

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
